notes.title: The Legend of Gandar III
notes.content:
An epic fantasy world returns.
This is the next chapter of the highly anticipated The Legend of Gandar III installment, developed by Jeddead.
The Legend of Gandar III takes place two years after the events of The Legend of Gandar II and The Legend of Gandar.
This game will feature several more challenging bosses, dungeons, and enemies.
It will also feature new and epic soundtracks.

notes.title: New dungeon "Tomb of Alexander I.
notes.content:
Lisa & Ben accidentally find the tomb of Alexander I and encounter mysterious creatures.
Will they find out what's going on there?
The tomb is west of Kabunek Castle.

Features

• Route 10 added
• Added 2x new Npc
• Added new dungeon
• Added new soundtrack
• Added 2x new skills (Fire Breath, Elemental Attack).
• 4x new enemies 8!x boss of them) Added
• Images edited on Steam

Fixes

• Troll lair made easier
• Exp edited

notes.title: New dungeon "The undead"
notes.content:
A resident of the city of Gandar has had a strange encounter and is worried about his body and the city.
Maybe you can help him. You can find him in the city of Gandar.

notes.title: New Dungeon "An Ancient Tomb"
notes.content:
In the house of the medicinal herb woman they found an old book that describes something.
Find this house and examine it it after a book, then you will find out what it is all about.

notes.title: Added new side quest Amulet of Peace
notes.content:
We have now added a small side quest to the game.
It is an amulet that you should find a woman.
You can find this woman (for the quest) in the marketplace by a fountain.
But you should be well equipped for the quest.
